name: claude-classic-list-files
notes: Classic renderer, a read-only Bash call (auto-allowed), then a long markdown answer with a table that scrolls the screen.
prompt: list the files in this repository and summarise what each one does

content.text:
Here is every file in the repository and what it does.

## Overview

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `README.md` | A one-paragraph description of the project |
| `package.json` | Package metadata; `npm test` runs `node --test test/` |
| `.gitignore` | Keeps `node_modules/` out of git |
| `src/math.js` | `add(a, b)` and `sub(a, b)` |
| `src/hello.js` | `greet(name)`, which returns a greeting string |
| `src/counter.js` | A module-level counter with `next()` |
| `src/index.js` | Entry point: prints a greeting and `add(2, 3)` |
| `test/math.test.js` | Tests for `add` and `sub` |
| `test/counter.test.js` | Tests that `next()` counts up from 1 |

## Source modules

- **`src/math.js`** exports two pure functions. Both take two numbers and return a number; there is no input validation.
- **`src/hello.js`** builds the greeting with a template literal. Note that the greeting text contains a typo (`Helo`).
- **`src/counter.js`** keeps its state in a module-level variable named `x`, so every importer shares one counter.
- **`src/index.js`** wires the modules together and logs the result when run with `node src/index.js`.

## Tests

1. `test/math.test.js` checks `add(2, 3) === 5` and `sub(5, 3) === 2`.
2. `test/counter.test.js` checks that the first two calls to `next()` return 1 and 2.

## Suggestions

- Fix the typo in `src/hello.js` and add a test for `greet`.
- Rename `x` in `src/counter.js` to something descriptive such as `count`.
- Add a `.gitignore` entry for a `build/` folder if one is ever added.

That's the whole project: nine source files plus the marker file used by the demo tooling.
